name: Otome Boyfriend
source:
A visual novel designed for quick yet meaningful interactions. Each playthrough features short scenarios where your choices shape the flow of the story.

Build connections with three characters and discover where your path leads – toward one of six unique endings filled with warmth, laughter, and romance.

[From [url=https://chulagames.itch.io/otome-boyfriend]Itch.io[/url]]
